title: CancelAccountDeletionResponse
description: CancelAccountDeletion is a no-body Command (registry requestBody: none, doc 28 §8): the client sends no request body and OpenAPI declares no requestBody, so this file's root is the Response and no request schema exists. FR-AUTH-031: restore to the pre-deletion status (Active or PendingVerification), userId unchanged; reachable only while the account is DeletionPending, otherwise the AccountNotInDeletion error applies.
